code:
def sum_evens(nums):
    return sum(n for n in nums if n % 2 == 0)
test:
assert sum_evens([1,2,3,4]) == 6
assert sum_evens([]) == 0
assert sum_evens([2]) == 2

assert sum_evens([1,2,3,4]) == 6
assert sum_evens([]) == 0
assert sum_evens([2]) == 2
bug: off-by-one: starts at index 1, misses nums[0]

code:
def clip(v, lo, hi):
    return max(lo, min(v, hi))
test:
assert clip(5, 0, 10) == 5
assert clip(-3, 0, 10) == 0
assert clip(15, 0, 10) == 10

code:
def last_word_len(s):
    return len(s.split()[-1]) if s.split() else 0
test:
assert last_word_len('hello world') == 5
assert last_word_len('a  b ') == 1
assert last_word_len('') == 0

code:
def is_sorted(lst):
    return all(lst[i] < lst[i+1] for i in range(len(lst)-1))
test:
assert is_sorted([1,2,2,3]) == True
assert is_sorted([3,1]) == False
